qualificationLimits: Existing one-based numeric/boolean cells in complete modern Numbers content without selected formulas or unsupported cell features. Decimal128 numeric cells, double-backed booleans, active BNCv5 and absent/empty selected legacy cell only.
Insertion, type changes, style/layout changes, shared tiles, populated legacy representations, double-backed numbers and nested-index mutations are rejected.
Only fixed-width requested scalar ranges change. Pending edits compose and assigning the original projected value restores its original scalar bytes.
Native previews and visual caches remain retained/unrefreshed and require explicit acceptance. Wider application metadata is unassessed.
Native and saved/reopened XLSX values agree. Canonical region-padding omission remains explicit; complete composed Numbers PDF is rejected for this profile.
Actual .NET8/.NET10 NativeAOT execution on macOS arm64 only for this extension. Other architectures, PDF AOT, native host, physical-device and broader cancellation acceptance remain separate.
